20×27×26 foretorso dominates18×20×19 hindbody. Head combines two broad/muzzle masses; four horn boxes are children of one rotated horn node, not four independent articulated horns.
No knee/jaw/held-item socket or terrain-contact solver. Name arm means foreleg, not humanoid arm.

Chargeprogress is prev/current interpolation with partialTick=age-tickCount. Entity increments to5 whilecharging and decreases to0 whennot; this is pose ramp, not server damage clock.

Gait still switches discretely at progress>0; running pairs both forelegs together vs rear pair, walking diagonal. On interruption remaining positive progress retains charge gait until zero. It is not demonstrated to be a smooth full-body blend.
